def extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file):
    """
    extract feature name from bitanswer license 
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_list = []
    feature_name_rep = re.compile('name=\"([\w\-]+)\s+[\d\.]+\"')
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if '<feature' in line and 'id' in line and 'name' in line:
                feature_list.append(feature_name_rep.findall(line)[0])
    return feature_list


def deploy_to_flex(server_ip, remote_license_file, license_file):
    """
    deploy the license file to flex server
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_file:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to flex: {server_ip}")
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_file)
    remote_lmreread = f"{remote_workspace}/lmreread"
    remote_lmstat = f"{remote_workspace}/lmstat"
    bk_time_sfx = time.strftime('%Y%mNaN')
    # backup remote license file on remote host
    execute_ssh_command(f"cp -rf {remote_license_file} {remote_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}", server_ip)
    # backup remote license file on localhost
    flex_license_backup_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'flex_license_backup_folder', server_ip)
    if not os.path.exists(flex_license_backup_folder):
        os.makedirs(flex_license_backup_folder, exist_ok=True)
    local_main_license_file = remote_license_file_name = os.path.basename(remote_license_file)
    flex_license_backup = os.path.join(flex_license_backup_folder, f'{local_main_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}')
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, flex_license_backup)
    # modify the main license file on local
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, local_main_license_file)
    ## extract features from license file
    feature_list, feature_lines = extract_feature_line_flex(license_file)
    ## locate the index to insert the new features
    insert_index = 0
    with open(local_main_license_file, 'r') as fro:
        all_lines = fro.readlines()
    for index, line in enumerate(all_lines):
        if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
            insert_index = index
    if insert_index:
        new_file_lines = []
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[:insert_index])
        new_file_lines.extend(feature_lines)
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[insert_index:])
        with open(local_main_license_file, 'w') as fwo:
            fwo.writelines(new_file_lines)
    else:
        raise BaseException(f'cannot found the insert position from {local_main_license_file}')
    # upload the license file and modified license file to remote
    upload_file(server_ip, local_main_license_file, remote_license_file)
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, f"{remote_workspace}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}")
    # call remote lmreread to apply it and check output
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmreread} -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)
    format_print(output)
    # check lmstat output
    lmstat_output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmstat} -i -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # lmreread successful
    enabled_feature = []
    for feature_name in feature_list:
        if f'{feature_name} ' in lmstat_output:
            format_print(f'{feature_name} has been enabled on flexnet:{server_ip}.')
            enabled_feature.append(feature_name)
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")

def deploy_to_bitanswer(server_ip, remote_license_folder, license_file):
    """
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_folder:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to bitanswer: {server_ip}")
    SN = os.path.basename(license_file).split('-')[0]
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_folder)
    remote_bit_service = f"{remote_workspace}/bit_service"
    remote_license_file = f"{remote_license_folder}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}"

    # upload to remote license folder to store
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, remote_license_file)
    # call remote bit_service to apply it
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"{remote_bit_service} -f {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # Apply update file successfully
    # check output
    format_print(output)
    # user bit_service -feature feature_name to check
    feature_list = extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file)
    enabled_feature = []

    feature_status = execute_ssh_command(f'{remote_bit_service} -feature -l {SN}', server_ip)
    feature_status_keywords = feature_status.split()
    for feature in feature_list:
        if feature in feature_status_keywords:
            enabled_feature.append(feature)
            format_print(f'{feature} has been enabled on bitanswer:{server_ip}.')
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")


def generate_license_file(excel_file):
    """
    call the lic_generator
    :param excel_file:
    :return:
    """
    sys.path.append(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(WORKSPACE, '..')))
    from lic_gen.lic_generator import local_flow
    shutil.copy(FEATURE_BOOK_PATH, os.path.join('D:\\lic_gen', FEATURE_BOOK_NAME))

    local_license_file_list = []
    record_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'update_record')
    license_files = local_flow(excel_file)
    for license_file in license_files:
        try:
            local_license_file = os.path.join(record_folder, os.path.basename(license_file))
            shutil.copy(license_file, local_license_file)
            local_license_file_list.append(local_license_file)
        except Exception as e:
            format_print(f"generate license file failed: {e}")
    return local_license_file_list

def extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file):
    """
    extract feature name from bitanswer license 
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_list = []
    feature_name_rep = re.compile('name=\"([\w\-]+)\s+[\d\.]+\"')
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if '<feature' in line and 'id' in line and 'name' in line:
                feature_list.append(feature_name_rep.findall(line)[0])
    return feature_list


def deploy_to_flex(server_ip, remote_license_file, license_file):
    """
    deploy the license file to flex server
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_file:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to flex: {server_ip}")
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_file)
    remote_lmreread = f"{remote_workspace}/lmreread"
    remote_lmstat = f"{remote_workspace}/lmstat"
    bk_time_sfx = time.strftime('%Y%mNaN')
    # backup remote license file on remote host
    execute_ssh_command(f"cp -rf {remote_license_file} {remote_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}", server_ip)
    # backup remote license file on localhost
    flex_license_backup_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'flex_license_backup_folder', server_ip)
    if not os.path.exists(flex_license_backup_folder):
        os.makedirs(flex_license_backup_folder, exist_ok=True)
    local_main_license_file = remote_license_file_name = os.path.basename(remote_license_file)
    flex_license_backup = os.path.join(flex_license_backup_folder, f'{local_main_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}')
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, flex_license_backup)
    # modify the main license file on local
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, local_main_license_file)
    ## extract features from license file
    feature_list, feature_lines = extract_feature_line_flex(license_file)
    ## locate the index to insert the new features
    insert_index = 0
    with open(local_main_license_file, 'r') as fro:
        all_lines = fro.readlines()
    for index, line in enumerate(all_lines):
        if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
            insert_index = index
    if insert_index:
        new_file_lines = []
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[:insert_index])
        new_file_lines.extend(feature_lines)
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[insert_index:])
        with open(local_main_license_file, 'w') as fwo:
            fwo.writelines(new_file_lines)
    else:
        raise BaseException(f'cannot found the insert position from {local_main_license_file}')
    # upload the license file and modified license file to remote
    upload_file(server_ip, local_main_license_file, remote_license_file)
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, f"{remote_workspace}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}")
    # call remote lmreread to apply it and check output
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmreread} -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)
    format_print(output)
    # check lmstat output
    lmstat_output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmstat} -i -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # lmreread successful
    enabled_feature = []
    for feature_name in feature_list:
        if f'{feature_name} ' in lmstat_output:
            format_print(f'{feature_name} has been enabled on flexnet:{server_ip}.')
            enabled_feature.append(feature_name)
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")

def deploy_to_bitanswer(server_ip, remote_license_folder, license_file):
    """
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_folder:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to bitanswer: {server_ip}")
    SN = os.path.basename(license_file).split('-')[0]
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_folder)
    remote_bit_service = f"{remote_workspace}/bit_service"
    remote_license_file = f"{remote_license_folder}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}"

    # upload to remote license folder to store
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, remote_license_file)
    # call remote bit_service to apply it
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"{remote_bit_service} -f {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # Apply update file successfully
    # check output
    format_print(output)
    # user bit_service -feature feature_name to check
    feature_list = extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file)
    enabled_feature = []

    feature_status = execute_ssh_command(f'{remote_bit_service} -feature -l {SN}', server_ip)
    feature_status_keywords = feature_status.split()
    for feature in feature_list:
        if feature in feature_status_keywords:
            enabled_feature.append(feature)
            format_print(f'{feature} has been enabled on bitanswer:{server_ip}.')
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")


def generate_license_file(excel_file):
    """
    call the lic_generator
    :param excel_file:
    :return:
    """
    sys.path.append(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(WORKSPACE, '..')))
    from lic_gen.lic_generator import local_flow
    shutil.copy(FEATURE_BOOK_PATH, os.path.join('D:\\lic_gen', FEATURE_BOOK_NAME))

    local_license_file_list = []
    record_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'update_record')
    license_files = local_flow(excel_file)
    for license_file in license_files:
        try:
            local_license_file = os.path.join(record_folder, os.path.basename(license_file))
            shutil.copy(license_file, local_license_file)
            local_license_file_list.append(local_license_file)
        except Exception as e:
            format_print(f"generate license file failed: {e}")
    return local_license_file_list

def extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file):
    """
    extract feature name from bitanswer license 
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_list = []
    feature_name_rep = re.compile('name=\"([\w\-]+)\s+[\d\.]+\"')
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if '<feature' in line and 'id' in line and 'name' in line:
                feature_list.append(feature_name_rep.findall(line)[0])
    return feature_list


def deploy_to_flex(server_ip, remote_license_file, license_file):
    """
    deploy the license file to flex server
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_file:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to flex: {server_ip}")
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_file)
    remote_lmreread = f"{remote_workspace}/lmreread"
    remote_lmstat = f"{remote_workspace}/lmstat"
    bk_time_sfx = time.strftime('%Y%mNaN')
    # backup remote license file on remote host
    execute_ssh_command(f"cp -rf {remote_license_file} {remote_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}", server_ip)
    # backup remote license file on localhost
    flex_license_backup_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'flex_license_backup_folder', server_ip)
    if not os.path.exists(flex_license_backup_folder):
        os.makedirs(flex_license_backup_folder, exist_ok=True)
    local_main_license_file = remote_license_file_name = os.path.basename(remote_license_file)
    flex_license_backup = os.path.join(flex_license_backup_folder, f'{local_main_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}')
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, flex_license_backup)
    # modify the main license file on local
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, local_main_license_file)
    ## extract features from license file
    feature_list, feature_lines = extract_feature_line_flex(license_file)
    ## locate the index to insert the new features
    insert_index = 0
    with open(local_main_license_file, 'r') as fro:
        all_lines = fro.readlines()
    for index, line in enumerate(all_lines):
        if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
            insert_index = index
    if insert_index:
        new_file_lines = []
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[:insert_index])
        new_file_lines.extend(feature_lines)
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[insert_index:])
        with open(local_main_license_file, 'w') as fwo:
            fwo.writelines(new_file_lines)
    else:
        raise BaseException(f'cannot found the insert position from {local_main_license_file}')
    # upload the license file and modified license file to remote
    upload_file(server_ip, local_main_license_file, remote_license_file)
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, f"{remote_workspace}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}")
    # call remote lmreread to apply it and check output
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmreread} -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)
    format_print(output)
    # check lmstat output
    lmstat_output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmstat} -i -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # lmreread successful
    enabled_feature = []
    for feature_name in feature_list:
        if f'{feature_name} ' in lmstat_output:
            format_print(f'{feature_name} has been enabled on flexnet:{server_ip}.')
            enabled_feature.append(feature_name)
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")

def deploy_to_bitanswer(server_ip, remote_license_folder, license_file):
    """
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_folder:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to bitanswer: {server_ip}")
    SN = os.path.basename(license_file).split('-')[0]
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_folder)
    remote_bit_service = f"{remote_workspace}/bit_service"
    remote_license_file = f"{remote_license_folder}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}"

    # upload to remote license folder to store
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, remote_license_file)
    # call remote bit_service to apply it
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"{remote_bit_service} -f {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # Apply update file successfully
    # check output
    format_print(output)
    # user bit_service -feature feature_name to check
    feature_list = extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file)
    enabled_feature = []

    feature_status = execute_ssh_command(f'{remote_bit_service} -feature -l {SN}', server_ip)
    feature_status_keywords = feature_status.split()
    for feature in feature_list:
        if feature in feature_status_keywords:
            enabled_feature.append(feature)
            format_print(f'{feature} has been enabled on bitanswer:{server_ip}.')
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")


def generate_license_file(excel_file):
    """
    call the lic_generator
    :param excel_file:
    :return:
    """
    sys.path.append(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(WORKSPACE, '..')))
    from lic_gen.lic_generator import local_flow
    shutil.copy(FEATURE_BOOK_PATH, os.path.join('D:\\lic_gen', FEATURE_BOOK_NAME))

    local_license_file_list = []
    record_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'update_record')
    license_files = local_flow(excel_file)
    for license_file in license_files:
        try:
            local_license_file = os.path.join(record_folder, os.path.basename(license_file))
            shutil.copy(license_file, local_license_file)
            local_license_file_list.append(local_license_file)
        except Exception as e:
            format_print(f"generate license file failed: {e}")
    return local_license_file_list

def extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file):
    """
    extract feature name from bitanswer license 
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_list = []
    feature_name_rep = re.compile('name=\"([\w\-]+)\s+[\d\.]+\"')
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if '<feature' in line and 'id' in line and 'name' in line:
                feature_list.append(feature_name_rep.findall(line)[0])
    return feature_list


def deploy_to_flex(server_ip, remote_license_file, license_file):
    """
    deploy the license file to flex server
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_file:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to flex: {server_ip}")
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_file)
    remote_lmreread = f"{remote_workspace}/lmreread"
    remote_lmstat = f"{remote_workspace}/lmstat"
    bk_time_sfx = time.strftime('%Y%mNaN')
    # backup remote license file on remote host
    execute_ssh_command(f"cp -rf {remote_license_file} {remote_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}", server_ip)
    # backup remote license file on localhost
    flex_license_backup_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'flex_license_backup_folder', server_ip)
    if not os.path.exists(flex_license_backup_folder):
        os.makedirs(flex_license_backup_folder, exist_ok=True)
    local_main_license_file = remote_license_file_name = os.path.basename(remote_license_file)
    flex_license_backup = os.path.join(flex_license_backup_folder, f'{local_main_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}')
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, flex_license_backup)
    # modify the main license file on local
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, local_main_license_file)
    ## extract features from license file
    feature_list, feature_lines = extract_feature_line_flex(license_file)
    ## locate the index to insert the new features
    insert_index = 0
    with open(local_main_license_file, 'r') as fro:
        all_lines = fro.readlines()
    for index, line in enumerate(all_lines):
        if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
            insert_index = index
    if insert_index:
        new_file_lines = []
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[:insert_index])
        new_file_lines.extend(feature_lines)
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[insert_index:])
        with open(local_main_license_file, 'w') as fwo:
            fwo.writelines(new_file_lines)
    else:
        raise BaseException(f'cannot found the insert position from {local_main_license_file}')
    # upload the license file and modified license file to remote
    upload_file(server_ip, local_main_license_file, remote_license_file)
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, f"{remote_workspace}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}")
    # call remote lmreread to apply it and check output
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmreread} -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)
    format_print(output)
    # check lmstat output
    lmstat_output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmstat} -i -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # lmreread successful
    enabled_feature = []
    for feature_name in feature_list:
        if f'{feature_name} ' in lmstat_output:
            format_print(f'{feature_name} has been enabled on flexnet:{server_ip}.')
            enabled_feature.append(feature_name)
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")

def deploy_to_bitanswer(server_ip, remote_license_folder, license_file):
    """
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_folder:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to bitanswer: {server_ip}")
    SN = os.path.basename(license_file).split('-')[0]
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_folder)
    remote_bit_service = f"{remote_workspace}/bit_service"
    remote_license_file = f"{remote_license_folder}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}"

    # upload to remote license folder to store
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, remote_license_file)
    # call remote bit_service to apply it
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"{remote_bit_service} -f {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # Apply update file successfully
    # check output
    format_print(output)
    # user bit_service -feature feature_name to check
    feature_list = extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file)
    enabled_feature = []

    feature_status = execute_ssh_command(f'{remote_bit_service} -feature -l {SN}', server_ip)
    feature_status_keywords = feature_status.split()
    for feature in feature_list:
        if feature in feature_status_keywords:
            enabled_feature.append(feature)
            format_print(f'{feature} has been enabled on bitanswer:{server_ip}.')
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")


def generate_license_file(excel_file):
    """
    call the lic_generator
    :param excel_file:
    :return:
    """
    sys.path.append(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(WORKSPACE, '..')))
    from lic_gen.lic_generator import local_flow
    shutil.copy(FEATURE_BOOK_PATH, os.path.join('D:\\lic_gen', FEATURE_BOOK_NAME))

    local_license_file_list = []
    record_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'update_record')
    license_files = local_flow(excel_file)
    for license_file in license_files:
        try:
            local_license_file = os.path.join(record_folder, os.path.basename(license_file))
            shutil.copy(license_file, local_license_file)
            local_license_file_list.append(local_license_file)
        except Exception as e:
            format_print(f"generate license file failed: {e}")
    return local_license_file_list

def deploy_to_bitanswer(server_ip, remote_license_folder, license_file):
    """
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_folder:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to bitanswer: {server_ip}")
    SN = os.path.basename(license_file).split('-')[0]

def extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file):
    """
    extract feature name from bitanswer license 
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_list = []
    feature_name_rep = re.compile('name=\"([\w\-]+)\s+[\d\.]+\"')
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if '<feature' in line and 'id' in line and 'name' in line:
                feature_list.append(feature_name_rep.findall(line)[0])
    return feature_list


def deploy_to_flex(server_ip, remote_license_file, license_file):
    """
    deploy the license file to flex server
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_file:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to flex: {server_ip}")
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_file)
    remote_lmreread = f"{remote_workspace}/lmreread"
    remote_lmstat = f"{remote_workspace}/lmstat"
    bk_time_sfx = time.strftime('%Y%mNaN')
    # backup remote license file on remote host
    execute_ssh_command(f"cp -rf {remote_license_file} {remote_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}", server_ip)
    # backup remote license file on localhost
    flex_license_backup_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'flex_license_backup_folder', server_ip)
    if not os.path.exists(flex_license_backup_folder):
        os.makedirs(flex_license_backup_folder, exist_ok=True)
    local_main_license_file = remote_license_file_name = os.path.basename(remote_license_file)
    flex_license_backup = os.path.join(flex_license_backup_folder, f'{local_main_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}')
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, flex_license_backup)
    # modify the main license file on local
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, local_main_license_file)
    ## extract features from license file
    feature_list, feature_lines = extract_feature_line_flex(license_file)
    ## locate the index to insert the new features
    insert_index = 0
    with open(local_main_license_file, 'r') as fro:
        all_lines = fro.readlines()
    for index, line in enumerate(all_lines):
        if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
            insert_index = index
    if insert_index:
        new_file_lines = []
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[:insert_index])
        new_file_lines.extend(feature_lines)
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[insert_index:])
        with open(local_main_license_file, 'w') as fwo:
            fwo.writelines(new_file_lines)
    else:
        raise BaseException(f'cannot found the insert position from {local_main_license_file}')
    # upload the license file and modified license file to remote
    upload_file(server_ip, local_main_license_file, remote_license_file)
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, f"{remote_workspace}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}")
    # call remote lmreread to apply it and check output
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmreread} -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)
    format_print(output)
    # check lmstat output
    lmstat_output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmstat} -i -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # lmreread successful
    enabled_feature = []
    for feature_name in feature_list:
        if f'{feature_name} ' in lmstat_output:
            format_print(f'{feature_name} has been enabled on flexnet:{server_ip}.')
            enabled_feature.append(feature_name)
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")

def deploy_to_bitanswer(server_ip, remote_license_folder, license_file):
    """
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_folder:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to bitanswer: {server_ip}")
    SN = os.path.basename(license_file).split('-')[0]
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_folder)
    remote_bit_service = f"{remote_workspace}/bit_service"
    remote_license_file = f"{remote_license_folder}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}"

    # upload to remote license folder to store
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, remote_license_file)
    # call remote bit_service to apply it
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"{remote_bit_service} -f {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # Apply update file successfully
    # check output
    format_print(output)
    # user bit_service -feature feature_name to check
    feature_list = extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file)
    enabled_feature = []

    feature_status = execute_ssh_command(f'{remote_bit_service} -feature -l {SN}', server_ip)
    feature_status_keywords = feature_status.split()
    for feature in feature_list:
        if feature in feature_status_keywords:
            enabled_feature.append(feature)
            format_print(f'{feature} has been enabled on bitanswer:{server_ip}.')
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")


def generate_license_file(excel_file):
    """
    call the lic_generator
    :param excel_file:
    :return:
    """
    sys.path.append(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(WORKSPACE, '..')))
    from lic_gen.lic_generator import local_flow
    shutil.copy(FEATURE_BOOK_PATH, os.path.join('D:\\lic_gen', FEATURE_BOOK_NAME))

    local_license_file_list = []
    record_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'update_record')
    license_files = local_flow(excel_file)
    for license_file in license_files:
        try:
            local_license_file = os.path.join(record_folder, os.path.basename(license_file))
            shutil.copy(license_file, local_license_file)
            local_license_file_list.append(local_license_file)
        except Exception as e:
            format_print(f"generate license file failed: {e}")
    return local_license_file_list

def extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file):
    """
    extract feature name from bitanswer license 
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_list = []
    feature_name_rep = re.compile('name=\"([\w\-]+)\s+[\d\.]+\"')
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if '<feature' in line and 'id' in line and 'name' in line:
                feature_list.append(feature_name_rep.findall(line)[0])
    return feature_list


def deploy_to_flex(server_ip, remote_license_file, license_file):
    """
    deploy the license file to flex server
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_file:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to flex: {server_ip}")
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_file)
    remote_lmreread = f"{remote_workspace}/lmreread"
    remote_lmstat = f"{remote_workspace}/lmstat"
    bk_time_sfx = time.strftime('%Y%mNaN')
    # backup remote license file on remote host
    execute_ssh_command(f"cp -rf {remote_license_file} {remote_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}", server_ip)
    # backup remote license file on localhost
    flex_license_backup_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'flex_license_backup_folder', server_ip)
    if not os.path.exists(flex_license_backup_folder):
        os.makedirs(flex_license_backup_folder, exist_ok=True)
    local_main_license_file = remote_license_file_name = os.path.basename(remote_license_file)
    flex_license_backup = os.path.join(flex_license_backup_folder, f'{local_main_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}')
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, flex_license_backup)
    # modify the main license file on local
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, local_main_license_file)
    ## extract features from license file
    feature_list, feature_lines = extract_feature_line_flex(license_file)
    ## locate the index to insert the new features
    insert_index = 0
    with open(local_main_license_file, 'r') as fro:
        all_lines = fro.readlines()
    for index, line in enumerate(all_lines):
        if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
            insert_index = index
    if insert_index:
        new_file_lines = []
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[:insert_index])
        new_file_lines.extend(feature_lines)
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[insert_index:])
        with open(local_main_license_file, 'w') as fwo:
            fwo.writelines(new_file_lines)
    else:
        raise BaseException(f'cannot found the insert position from {local_main_license_file}')
    # upload the license file and modified license file to remote
    upload_file(server_ip, local_main_license_file, remote_license_file)
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, f"{remote_workspace}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}")
    # call remote lmreread to apply it and check output
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmreread} -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)
    format_print(output)
    # check lmstat output
    lmstat_output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmstat} -i -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # lmreread successful
    enabled_feature = []
    for feature_name in feature_list:
        if f'{feature_name} ' in lmstat_output:
            format_print(f'{feature_name} has been enabled on flexnet:{server_ip}.')
            enabled_feature.append(feature_name)
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")
    print(f<|fim_suffix|>)


def deploy_to_bitanswer(server_ip, remote_license_folder, license_file):
    """
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_folder:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to bitanswer: {server_ip}")
    SN = os.path.basename(license_file).split('-')[0]
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_folder)
    remote_bit_service = f"{remote_workspace}/bit_service"
    remote_license_file = f"{remote_license_folder}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}"

    # upload to remote license folder to store
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, remote_license_file)
    # call remote bit_service to apply it
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"{remote_bit_service} -f {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # Apply update file successfully
    # check output
    format_print(output)
    # user bit_service -feature feature_name to check
    feature_list = extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file)
    enabled_feature = []

    feature_status = execute_ssh_command(f'{remote_bit_service} -feature -l {SN}', server_ip)
    feature_status_keywords = feature_status.split()
    for feature in feature_list:
        if feature in feature_status_keywords:
            enabled_feature.append(feature)
            format_print(f'{feature} has been enabled on bitanswer:{server_ip}.')
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")


def generate_license_file(excel_file):
    """
    call the lic_generator
    :param excel_file:
    :return:
    """
    sys.path.append(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(WORKSPACE, '..')))
    from lic_gen.lic_generator import local_flow
    shutil.copy(FEATURE_BOOK_PATH, os.path.join('D:\\lic_gen', FEATURE_BOOK_NAME))

    local_license_file_list = []
    record_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'update_record')
    license_files = local_flow(excel_file)
    for license_file in license_files:
        try:
            local_license_file = os.path.join(record_folder, os.path.basename(license_file))
            shutil.copy(license_file, local_license_file)
            local_license_file_list.append(local_license_file)
        except Exception as e:
            format_print(f"generate license file failed: {e}")
    return local_license_file_list

def extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file):
    """
    extract feature name from bitanswer license 
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_list = []
    feature_name_rep = re.compile('name=\"([\w\-]+)\s+[\d\.]+\"')
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if '<feature' in line and 'id' in line and 'name' in line:
                feature_list.append(feature_name_rep.findall(line)[0])
    return feature_list


def deploy_to_flex(server_ip, remote_license_file, license_file):
    """
    deploy the license file to flex server
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_file:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to flex: {server_ip}")
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_file)
    remote_lmreread = f"{remote_workspace}/lmreread"
    remote_lmstat = f"{remote_workspace}/lmstat"
    bk_time_sfx = time.strftime('%Y%mNaN')
    # backup remote license file on remote host
    execute_ssh_command(f"cp -rf {remote_license_file} {remote_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}", server_ip)
    # backup remote license file on localhost
    flex_license_backup_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'flex_license_backup_folder', server_ip)
    if not os.path.exists(flex_license_backup_folder):
        os.makedirs(flex_license_backup_folder, exist_ok=True)
    local_main_license_file = remote_license_file_name = os.path.basename(remote_license_file)
    flex_license_backup = os.path.join(flex_license_backup_folder, f'{local_main_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}')
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, flex_license_backup)
    # modify the main license file on local
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, local_main_license_file)
    ## extract features from license file
    feature_list, feature_lines = extract_feature_line_flex(license_file)
    ## locate the index to insert the new features
    insert_index = 0
    with open(local_main_license_file, 'r') as fro:
        all_lines = fro.readlines()
    for index, line in enumerate(all_lines):
        if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
            insert_index = index
    if insert_index:
        new_file_lines = []
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[:insert_index])
        new_file_lines.extend(feature_lines)
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[insert_index:])
        with open(local_main_license_file, 'w') as fwo:
            fwo.writelines(new_file_lines)
    else:
        raise BaseException(f'cannot found the insert position from {local_main_license_file}')
    # upload the license file and modified license file to remote
    upload_file(server_ip, local_main_license_file, remote_license_file)
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, f"{remote_workspace}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}")
    # call remote lmreread to apply it and check output
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmreread} -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)
    format_print(output)
    # check lmstat output
    lmstat_output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmstat} -i -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # lmreread successful
    enabled_feature = []
    for feature_name in feature_list:
        if f'{feature_name} ' in lmstat_output:
            format_print(f'{feature_name} has been enabled on flexnet:{server_ip}.')
            enabled_feature.append(feature_name)
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")<|fim_suffix|>


def deploy_to_bitanswer(server_ip, remote_license_folder, license_file):
    """
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_folder:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to bitanswer: {server_ip}")
    SN = os.path.basename(license_file).split('-')[0]
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_folder)
    remote_bit_service = f"{remote_workspace}/bit_service"
    remote_license_file = f"{remote_license_folder}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}"

    # upload to remote license folder to store
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, remote_license_file)
    # call remote bit_service to apply it
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"{remote_bit_service} -f {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # Apply update file successfully
    # check output
    format_print(output)
    # user bit_service -feature feature_name to check
    feature_list = extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file)
    enabled_feature = []

    feature_status = execute_ssh_command(f'{remote_bit_service} -feature -l {SN}', server_ip)
    feature_status_keywords = feature_status.split()
    for feature in feature_list:
        if feature in feature_status_keywords:
            enabled_feature.append(feature)
            format_print(f'{feature} has been enabled on bitanswer:{server_ip}.')
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")


def generate_license_file(excel_file):
    """
    call the lic_generator
    :param excel_file:
    :return:
    """
    sys.path.append(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(WORKSPACE, '..')))
    from lic_gen.lic_generator import local_flow
    shutil.copy(FEATURE_BOOK_PATH, os.path.join('D:\\lic_gen', FEATURE_BOOK_NAME))

    local_license_file_list = []
    record_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'update_record')
    license_files = local_flow(excel_file)
    for license_file in license_files:
        try:
            local_license_file = os.path.join(record_folder, os.path.basename(license_file))
            shutil.copy(license_file, local_license_file)
            local_license_file_list.append(local_license_file)
        except Exception as e:
            format_print(f"generate license file failed: {e}")
    return local_license_file_list

def extract_feature_line_flex(license_file):
    """
    extract feature lines from flexnet license file
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_block = []
    feature_list = []
    feature_start = False
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if line.startswith('FEATURE') or line.startswith('INCREMENT'):
                feature_start = True
                feature_list.append(line.split()[1])
            if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
                break
            if feature_start:
                feature_block.append(line)
    return feature_list, feature_block


def extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file):
    """
    extract feature name from bitanswer license 
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_list = []
    feature_name_rep = re.compile('name=\"([\w\-]+)\s+[\d\.]+\"')
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if '<feature' in line and 'id' in line and 'name' in line:
                feature_list.append(feature_name_rep.findall(line)[0])
    return feature_list


def deploy_to_flex(server_ip, remote_license_file, license_file):
    """
    deploy the license file to flex server
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_file:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to flex: {server_ip}")
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_file)
    remote_lmreread = f"{remote_workspace}/lmreread"
    remote_lmstat = f"{remote_workspace}/lmstat"
    bk_time_sfx = time.strftime('%Y%mNaN')
    # backup remote license file on remote host
    execute_ssh_command(f"cp -rf {remote_license_file} {remote_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}", server_ip)
    # backup remote license file on localhost
    flex_license_backup_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'flex_license_backup_folder', server_ip)
    if not os.path.exists(flex_license_backup_folder):
        os.makedirs(flex_license_backup_folder, exist_ok=True)
    local_main_license_file = remote_license_file_name = os.path.basename(remote_license_file)
    flex_license_backup = os.path.join(flex_license_backup_folder, f'{local_main_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}')
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, flex_license_backup)
    # modify the main license file on local
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, local_main_license_file)
    ## extract features from license file
    feature_list, feature_lines = extract_feature_line_flex(license_file)
    ## locate the index to insert the new features
    insert_index = 0
    with open(local_main_license_file, 'r') as fro:
        all_lines = fro.readlines()
    for index, line in enumerate(all_lines):
        if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
            insert_index = index
    if insert_index:
        new_file_lines = []
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[:insert_index])
        new_file_lines.extend(feature_lines)
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[insert_index:])
        with open(local_main_license_file, 'w') as fwo:
            fwo.writelines(new_file_lines)
    else:
        <|fim_suffix|>
        raise BaseException(f'cannot found the insert position from {local_main_license_file}')
    # upload the license file and modified license file to remote
    upload_file(server_ip, local_main_license_file, remote_license_file)
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, f"{remote_workspace}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}")
    # call remote lmreread to apply it and check output
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmreread} -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)
    format_print(output)
    # check lmstat output
    lmstat_output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmstat} -i -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # lmreread successful
    enabled_feature = []
    for feature_name in feature_list:
        if f'{feature_name} ' in lmstat_output:
            format_print(f'{feature_name} has been enabled on flexnet:{server_ip}.')
            enabled_feature.append(feature_name)
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")


def deploy_to_bitanswer(server_ip, remote_license_folder, license_file):
    """
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_folder:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to bitanswer: {server_ip}")
    SN = os.path.basename(license_file).split('-')[0]
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_folder)
    remote_bit_service = f"{remote_workspace}/bit_service"
    remote_license_file = f"{remote_license_folder}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}"

    # upload to remote license folder to store
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, remote_license_file)
    # call remote bit_service to apply it
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"{remote_bit_service} -f {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # Apply update file successfully
    # check output
    format_print(output)
    # user bit_service -feature feature_name to check
    feature_list = extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file)
    enabled_feature = []

    feature_status = execute_ssh_command(f'{remote_bit_service} -feature -l {SN}', server_ip)
    feature_status_keywords = feature_status.split()
    for feature in feature_list:
        if feature in feature_status_keywords:
            enabled_feature.append(feature)
            format_print(f'{feature} has been enabled on bitanswer:{server_ip}.')
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))

def extract_feature_line_flex(license_file):
    """
    extract feature lines from flexnet license file
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_block = []
    feature_list = []
    feature_start = False
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if line.startswith('FEATURE') or line.startswith('INCREMENT'):
                feature_start = True
                feature_list.append(line.split()[1])
            if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
                break
            if feature_start:
                feature_block.append(line)
    return feature_list, feature_block


def extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file):
    """
    extract feature name from bitanswer license 
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_list = []
    feature_name_rep = re.compile('name=\"([\w\-]+)\s+[\d\.]+\"')
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if '<feature' in line and 'id' in line and 'name' in line:
                feature_list.append(feature_name_rep.findall(line)[0])
    return feature_list


def deploy_to_flex(server_ip, remote_license_file, license_file):
    """
    deploy the license file to flex server
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_file:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to flex: {server_ip}")
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_file)
    remote_lmreread = f"{remote_workspace}/lmreread"
    remote_lmstat = f"{remote_workspace}/lmstat"
    bk_time_sfx = time.strftime('%Y%mNaN')
    # backup remote license file on remote host
    execute_ssh_command(f"cp -rf {remote_license_file} {remote_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}", server_ip)
    # backup remote license file on localhost
    flex_license_backup_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'flex_license_backup_folder', server_ip)
    if not os.path.exists(flex_license_backup_folder):
        os.makedirs(flex_license_backup_folder, exist_ok=True)
    local_main_license_file = remote_license_file_name = os.path.basename(remote_license_file)
    flex_license_backup = os.path.join(flex_license_backup_folder, f'{local_main_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}')
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, flex_license_backup)
    # modify the main license file on local
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, local_main_license_file)
    ## extract features from license file
    feature_list, feature_lines = extract_feature_line_flex(license_file)
    ## locate the index to insert the new features
    insert_index = 0
    with open(local_main_license_file, 'r') as fro:
        all_lines = fro.readlines()
    for index, line in enumerate(all_lines):
        if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
            insert_index = index
    if insert_index:
        new_file_lines = []
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[:insert_index])
        new_file_lines.extend(feature_lines)
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[insert_index:])
        with open(local_main_license_file, 'w') as fwo:
            fwo.writelines(new_file_lines)

        raise BaseException(f'cannot found the insert position from {local_main_license_file}')

    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, f"{remote_workspace}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}")
    # call remote lmreread to apply it and check output
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmreread} -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)
    format_print(output)
    # check lmstat output

    enabled_feature = []

            format_print(f'{feature_name} has been enabled on flexnet:{server_ip}.')
            enabled_feature.append(feature_name)
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:

    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")

def extract_feature_line_flex(license_file):
    """
    extract feature lines from flexnet license file
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_block = []
    feature_list = []
    feature_start = False
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if line.startswith('FEATURE') or line.startswith('INCREMENT'):
                feature_start = True
                feature_list.append(line.split()[1])
            if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
                break
            if feature_start:
                feature_block.append(line)
    return feature_list, feature_block


def extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file):
    """
    extract feature name from bitanswer license 
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_list = []
    feature_name_rep = re.compile('name=\"([\w\-]+)\s+[\d\.]+\"')
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if '<feature' in line and 'id' in line and 'name' in line:
                feature_list.append(feature_name_rep.findall(line)[0])
    return feature_list


def deploy_to_flex(server_ip, remote_license_file, license_file):
    """
    deploy the license file to flex server
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_file:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to flex: {server_ip}")
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_file)
    remote_lmreread = f"{remote_workspace}/lmreread"
    remote_lmstat = f"{remote_workspace}/lmstat"
    bk_time_sfx = time.strftime('%Y%mNaN')
    # backup remote license file on remote host
    execute_ssh_command(f"cp -rf {remote_license_file} {remote_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}", server_ip)
    # backup remote license file on localhost
    flex_license_backup_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'flex_license_backup_folder', server_ip)
    if not os.path.exists(flex_license_backup_folder):
        os.makedirs(flex_license_backup_folder, exist_ok=True)
    local_main_license_file = remote_license_file_name = os.path.basename(remote_license_file)
    flex_license_backup = os.path.join(flex_license_backup_folder, f'{local_main_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}')
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, flex_license_backup)
    # modify the main license file on local
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, local_main_license_file)
    ## extract features from license file
    feature_list, feature_lines = extract_feature_line_flex(license_file)
    ## locate the index to insert the new features
    insert_index = 0
    with open(local_main_license_file, 'r') as fro:
        all_lines = fro.readlines()
    for index, line in enumerate(all_lines):
        if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
            insert_index = index
    if insert_index:
        new_file_lines = []
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[:insert_index])
        new_file_lines.extend(feature_lines)
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[insert_index:])
        with open(local_main_license_file, 'w') as fwo:
            fwo.writelines(new_file_lines)
    else:
        f<|fim_suffix|>o
        raise BaseException(f'cannot found the insert position from {local_main_license_file}')
    # upload the license file and modified license file to remote
    upload_file(server_ip, local_main_license_file, remote_license_file)
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, f"{remote_workspace}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}")
    # call remote lmreread to apply it and check output
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmreread} -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)
    format_print(output)
    # check lmstat output
    lmstat_output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmstat} -i -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # lmreread successful
    enabled_feature = []
    for feature_name in feature_list:
        if f'{feature_name} ' in lmstat_output:
            format_print(f'{feature_name} has been enabled on flexnet:{server_ip}.')
            enabled_feature.append(feature_name)
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")


def deploy_to_bitanswer(server_ip, remote_license_folder, license_file):
    """
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_folder:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to bitanswer: {server_ip}")
    SN = os.path.basename(license_file).split('-')[0]
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_folder)
    remote_bit_service = f"{remote_workspace}/bit_service"
    remote_license_file = f"{remote_license_folder}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}"

    # upload to remote license folder to store
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, remote_license_file)
    # call remote bit_service to apply it
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"{remote_bit_service} -f {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # Apply update file successfully
    # check output
    format_print(output)
    # user bit_service -feature feature_name to check
    feature_list = extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file)
    enabled_feature = []

    feature_status = execute_ssh_command(f'{remote_bit_service} -feature -l {SN}', server_ip)
    feature_status_keywords = feature_status.split()
    for feature in feature_list:
        if feature in feature_status_keywords:
            enabled_feature.append(feature)
            format_print(f'{feature} has been enabled on bitanswer:{server_ip}.')
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))

        if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
            insert_index = index
    if insert_index:
        new_file_lines = []
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[:insert_index])
        new_file_lines.extend(feature_lines)
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[insert_index:])
        with open(local_main_license_file, 'w') as fwo:
            fwo.writelines(new_file_lines)
    else:
        for<|fim_suffix|>
        raise BaseException(f'cannot found the insert position from {local_main_license_file}')
    # upload the license file and modified license file to remote
    upload_file(server_ip, local_main_license_file, remote_license_file)
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, f"{remote_workspace}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}")
    # call remote lmreread to apply it and check output
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmreread} -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)
    format_print(output)
    # check lmstat output
    lmstat_output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmstat} -i -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # lmreread successful
    enabled_feature = []
    for feature_name in feature_list:
        if f'{feature_name} ' in lmstat_output:
            format_print(f'{feature_name} has been enabled on flexnet:{server_ip}.')
            enabled_feature.append(feature_name)
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")


def deploy_to_bitanswer(server_ip, remote_license_folder, license_file):
    """
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_folder:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to bitanswer: {server_ip}")
    SN = os.path.basename(license_file).split('-')[0]
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_folder)
    remote_bit_service = f"{remote_workspace}/bit_service"
    remote_license_file = f"{remote_license_folder}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}"

    # upload to remote license folder to store
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, remote_license_file)
    # call remote bit_service to apply it
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"{remote_bit_service} -f {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # Apply update file successfully
    # check output
    format_print(output)
    # user bit_service -feature feature_name to check
    feature_list = extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file)
    enabled_feature = []

    feature_status = execute_ssh_command(f'{remote_bit_service} -feature -l {SN}', server_ip)
    feature_status_keywords = feature_status.split()
    for feature in feature_list:
        if feature in feature_status_keywords:
            enabled_feature.append(feature)
            format_print(f'{feature} has been enabled on bitanswer:{server_ip}.')
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))

def extract_feature_line_flex(license_file):
    """
    extract feature lines from flexnet license file
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_block = []
    feature_list = []
    feature_start = False
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if line.startswith('FEATURE') or line.startswith('INCREMENT'):
                feature_start = True
                feature_list.append(line.split()[1])
            if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
                break
            if feature_start:
                feature_block.append(line)
    return feature_list, feature_block


def extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file):
    """
    extract feature name from bitanswer license 
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_list = []
    feature_name_rep = re.compile('name=\"([\w\-]+)\s+[\d\.]+\"')
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if '<feature' in line and 'id' in line and 'name' in line:
                feature_list.append(feature_name_rep.findall(line)[0])
    return feature_list


def deploy_to_flex(server_ip, remote_license_file, license_file):
    """
    deploy the license file to flex server
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_file:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to flex: {server_ip}")
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_file)
    remote_lmreread = f"{remote_workspace}/lmreread"
    remote_lmstat = f"{remote_workspace}/lmstat"
    bk_time_sfx = time.strftime('%Y%mNaN')
    # backup remote license file on remote host
    execute_ssh_command(f"cp -rf {remote_license_file} {remote_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}", server_ip)
    # backup remote license file on localhost
    flex_license_backup_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'flex_license_backup_folder', server_ip)
    if not os.path.exists(flex_license_backup_folder):
        os.makedirs(flex_license_backup_folder, exist_ok=True)
    local_main_license_file = remote_license_file_name = os.path.basename(remote_license_file)
    flex_license_backup = os.path.join(flex_license_backup_folder, f'{local_main_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}')
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, flex_license_backup)
    # modify the main license file on local
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, local_main_license_file)
    ## extract features from license file
    feature_list, feature_lines = extract_feature_line_flex(license_file)
    ## locate the index to insert the new features
    insert_index = 0
    with open(local_main_license_file, 'r') as fro:
        all_lines = fro.readlines()
    for index, line in enumerate(all_lines):
        if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
            insert_index = index
    if insert_index:
        new_file_lines = []
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[:insert_index])
        new_file_lines.extend(feature_lines)
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[insert_index:])
        with open(local_main_license_file, 'w') as fwo:
            fwo.writelines(new_file_lines)
    else:
        format<|fim_suffix|>
        raise BaseException(f'cannot found the insert position from {local_main_license_file}')
    # upload the license file and modified license file to remote
    upload_file(server_ip, local_main_license_file, remote_license_file)
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, f"{remote_workspace}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}")
    # call remote lmreread to apply it and check output
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmreread} -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)
    format_print(output)
    # check lmstat output
    lmstat_output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmstat} -i -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # lmreread successful
    enabled_feature = []
    for feature_name in feature_list:
        if f'{feature_name} ' in lmstat_output:
            format_print(f'{feature_name} has been enabled on flexnet:{server_ip}.')
            enabled_feature.append(feature_name)
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")


def deploy_to_bitanswer(server_ip, remote_license_folder, license_file):
    """
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_folder:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to bitanswer: {server_ip}")
    SN = os.path.basename(license_file).split('-')[0]
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_folder)
    remote_bit_service = f"{remote_workspace}/bit_service"
    remote_license_file = f"{remote_license_folder}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}"

    # upload to remote license folder to store
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, remote_license_file)
    # call remote bit_service to apply it
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"{remote_bit_service} -f {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # Apply update file successfully
    # check output
    format_print(output)
    # user bit_service -feature feature_name to check
    feature_list = extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file)
    enabled_feature = []

    feature_status = execute_ssh_command(f'{remote_bit_service} -feature -l {SN}', server_ip)
    feature_status_keywords = feature_status.split()
    for feature in feature_list:
        if feature in feature_status_keywords:
            enabled_feature.append(feature)
            format_print(f'{feature} has been enabled on bitanswer:{server_ip}.')
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))

def extract_feature_line_flex(license_file):
    """
    extract feature lines from flexnet license file
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_block = []
    feature_list = []
    feature_start = False
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if line.startswith('FEATURE') or line.startswith('INCREMENT'):
                feature_start = True
                feature_list.append(line.split()[1])
            if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
                break
            if feature_start:
                feature_block.append(line)
    return feature_list, feature_block


def extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file):
    """
    extract feature name from bitanswer license 
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_list = []
    feature_name_rep = re.compile('name=\"([\w\-]+)\s+[\d\.]+\"')
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if '<feature' in line and 'id' in line and 'name' in line:
                feature_list.append(feature_name_rep.findall(line)[0])
    return feature_list


def deploy_to_flex(server_ip, remote_license_file, license_file):
    """
    deploy the license file to flex server
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_file:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to flex: {server_ip}")
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_file)
    remote_lmreread = f"{remote_workspace}/lmreread"
    remote_lmstat = f"{remote_workspace}/lmstat"
    bk_time_sfx = time.strftime('%Y%mNaN')
    # backup remote license file on remote host
    execute_ssh_command(f"cp -rf {remote_license_file} {remote_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}", server_ip)
    # backup remote license file on localhost
    flex_license_backup_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'flex_license_backup_folder', server_ip)
    if not os.path.exists(flex_license_backup_folder):
        os.makedirs(flex_license_backup_folder, exist_ok=True)
    local_main_license_file = remote_license_file_name = os.path.basename(remote_license_file)
    flex_license_backup = os.path.join(flex_license_backup_folder, f'{local_main_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}')
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, flex_license_backup)
    # modify the main license file on local
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, local_main_license_file)
    ## extract features from license file
    feature_list, feature_lines = extract_feature_line_flex(license_file)
    ## locate the index to insert the new features
    insert_index = 0
    with open(local_main_license_file, 'r') as fro:
        all_lines = fro.readlines()
    for index, line in enumerate(all_lines):
        if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
            insert_index = index
    if insert_index:
        new_file_lines = []
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[:insert_index])
        new_file_lines.extend(feature_lines)
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[insert_index:])
        with open(local_main_license_file, 'w') as fwo:
            fwo.writelines(new_file_lines)
    else:
        format_print(f<|fim_suffix|>)
        raise BaseException(f'cannot found the insert position from {local_main_license_file}')
    # upload the license file and modified license file to remote
    upload_file(server_ip, local_main_license_file, remote_license_file)
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, f"{remote_workspace}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}")
    # call remote lmreread to apply it and check output
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmreread} -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)
    format_print(output)
    # check lmstat output
    lmstat_output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmstat} -i -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # lmreread successful
    enabled_feature = []
    for feature_name in feature_list:
        if f'{feature_name} ' in lmstat_output:
            format_print(f'{feature_name} has been enabled on flexnet:{server_ip}.')
            enabled_feature.append(feature_name)
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")

def extract_feature_line_flex(license_file):
    """
    extract feature lines from flexnet license file
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_block = []
    feature_list = []
    feature_start = False
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if line.startswith('FEATURE') or line.startswith('INCREMENT'):
                feature_start = True
                feature_list.append(line.split()[1])
            if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
                break
            if feature_start:
                feature_block.append(line)
    return feature_list, feature_block


def extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file):
    """
    extract feature name from bitanswer license 
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_list = []
    feature_name_rep = re.compile('name=\"([\w\-]+)\s+[\d\.]+\"')
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if '<feature' in line and 'id' in line and 'name' in line:
                feature_list.append(feature_name_rep.findall(line)[0])
    return feature_list


def deploy_to_flex(server_ip, remote_license_file, license_file):
    """
    deploy the license file to flex server

    local_main_license_file = remote_license_file_name = os.path.basename(remote_license_file)
    flex_license_backup = os.path.join(flex_license_backup_folder, f'{local_main_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}')
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, flex_license_backup)
    # modify the main license file on local
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, local_main_license_file)
    ## extract features from license file
    feature_list, feature_lines = extract_feature_line_flex(license_file)
    ## locate the index to insert the new features

    with open(local_main_license_file, 'r') as fro:

def deploy_to_bitanswer(server_ip, remote_license_folder, license_file):
    """
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_folder:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to bitanswer: {server_ip}")
    SN = os.path.basename(license_file).split('-')[0]
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_folder)
    remote_bit_service = f"{remote_workspace}/bit_service"
    remote_license_file = f"{remote_license_folder}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}"

    # upload to remote license folder to store
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, remote_license_file)
    # call remote bit_service to apply it
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"{remote_bit_service} -f {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # Apply update file successfully
    # check output
    format_print(output)
    # user bit_service -feature feature_name to check
    feature_list = extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file)
    enabled_feature = []

    feature_status = execute_ssh_command(f'{remote_bit_service} -feature -l {SN}', server_ip)
    feature_status_keywords = feature_status.split()
    for feature in feature_list:
        if feature in feature_status_keywords:
            enabled_feature.append(feature)
            format_print(f'{feature} has been enabled on bitanswer:{server_ip}.')
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))

def extract_bitanswer_feature(license_file):
    """
    extract feature name from bitanswer license 
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    feature_list = []
    feature_name_rep = re.compile('name=\"([\w\-]+)\s+[\d\.]+\"')
    with open(license_file, 'r') as file_read:
        for line in file_read.readlines():
            if '<feature' in line and 'id' in line and 'name' in line:
                feature_list.append(feature_name_rep.findall(line)[0])
    return feature_list


def deploy_to_flex(server_ip, remote_license_file, license_file):
    """
    deploy the license file to flex server
    :param server_ip:
    :param remote_license_file:
    :param license_file:
    :return:
    """
    format_print(f"deploy to flex: {server_ip}")
    remote_workspace = os.path.dirname(remote_license_file)
    remote_lmreread = f"{remote_workspace}/lmreread"
    remote_lmstat = f"{remote_workspace}/lmstat"
    bk_time_sfx = time.strftime('%Y%mNaN')
    # backup remote license file on remote host
    execute_ssh_command(f"cp -rf {remote_license_file} {remote_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}", server_ip)
    # backup remote license file on localhost
    flex_license_backup_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'flex_license_backup_folder', server_ip)
    if not os.path.exists(flex_license_backup_folder):
        os.makedirs(flex_license_backup_folder, exist_ok=True)
    local_main_license_file = remote_license_file_name = os.path.basename(remote_license_file)
    flex_license_backup = os.path.join(flex_license_backup_folder, f'{local_main_license_file}.{bk_time_sfx}')
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, flex_license_backup)
    # modify the main license file on local
    download_file(server_ip, remote_license_file, local_main_license_file)
    ## extract features from license file
    feature_list, feature_lines = extract_feature_line_flex(license_file)
    ## locate the index to insert the new features
    insert_index = 0
    with open(local_main_license_file, 'r') as fro:
        all_lines = fro.readlines()
    for index, line in enumerate(all_lines):
        if 'LICENSE KEYS END HERE' in line:
            insert_index = index
    if insert_index:
        new_file_lines = []
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[:insert_index])
        new_file_lines.extend(feature_lines)
        new_file_lines.extend(all_lines[insert_index:])
        with open(local_main_license_file, 'w') as fwo:
            fwo.writelines(new_file_lines)
        raise BaseException(f'cannot found the insert position from {local_main_license_file}')
    # upload the license file and modified license file to remote
    upload_file(server_ip, local_main_license_file, remote_license_file)
    upload_file(server_ip, license_file, f"{remote_workspace}/{os.path.basename(license_file)}")
    # call remote lmreread to apply it and check output
    output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmreread} -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)
    format_print(output)
    # check lmstat output
    lmstat_output = execute_ssh_command(f"setenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH ''; {remote_lmstat} -i -c {remote_license_file}", server_ip)  # lmreread successful
    enabled_feature = []
    for feature_name in feature_list:
        if f'{feature_name} ' in lmstat_output:
            format_print(f'{feature_name} has been enabled on flexnet:{server_ip}.')
            enabled_feature.append(feature_name)
    failed_feature = list(set(feature_list) - set(enabled_feature))
    if failed_feature:
        format_print(f"feature {failed_feature} failed to enable.")
    else:
        format_print(f"All features have been deployed on {server_ip}")
