def generate_license_file(excel_file):
    """
    call the lic_generator to generate license file according to the excel file
    :param excel_file:
    :return:
    """
    sys.path.append(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(WORKSPACE, '..')))
    from lic_gen.lic_generator import local_flow
    shutil.copy(FEATURE_BOOK_PATH, os.path.join('D:\\lic_gen', FEATURE_BOOK_NAME))

    local_license_file_list = []
    record_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'update_record')
    license_files = local_flow(excel_file)
    for license_file in license_files:
        try:
            local_license_file = os.path.join(record_folder, os.path.basename(license_file))
            shutil.copy(license_file, local_license_file)
            local_license_file_list.append(local_license_file)
        except Exception as e:
            format_print(f"generate license file failed: {e}")
    return local_license_file_list


def deploy_to_server(license_files):
    """
    deploy the license files to servers
    :param license_files: list of license files path
    :return: None
    """
    os.chdir(WORKSPACE)
    bitanser_daemon = 'bitanswer'
    flex_daemon = 'flex'
    server_ip_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': '192.168.120.136',
        'rjy-td9020': '172.16.19.20',
        'jn-jira': '192.168.123.78',
        'rjy-td3059': '172.16.13.59',
        'rjy-td6059': '172.16.16.59',
        'rjy-td9059': '172.16.19.59',
        'jn-vmbuild5': '192.168.121.170'
    }
    server_daemon_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': flex_daemon,
        'rjy-td9020': flex_daemon,
        'jn-vmbuild5': flex_daemon,
        'jn-jira': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td3059': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td6059': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td9059': bitanser_daemon

    }
    server_license_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': '/export/license/prima_server_pack/prima_jn-dell03.lic',
        'rjy-td9020': '/export/license_server/prima_server_pack/prima_rjy-td9020.lic',
        'jn-vmbuild5': '/export/license/prima_server_pack/prima_jn-vmbuild5.lic',
        'jn-jira': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td3059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td6059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td9059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
    }
    for license_file in license_files:
        license_file_name = os.path.basename(license_file)
        for machine_name, daemon in server_daemon_dict.items():
            machine_ip = server_ip_dict.get(machine_name)
            if machine_name in license_file_name:
                start_time = time.time()
                if daemon == flex_daemon:
                    deploy_to_flex(machine_ip, server_license_dict.get(machine_name, ''), license_file)
                elif daemon == bitanser_daemon:
                    deploy_to_bitanswer(machine_ip, server_license_dict.get(machine_name, ''), license_file)
                else:
                    format_print(f"unknown daemon type: {daemon}")
                format_print(f"time usage: {time.time()-start_time} for {machine_ip} {daemon}")

def generate_license_file(excel_file):
    """
    call the lic_generator to generate license file according to the excel file
    :param excel_file:
    :return:
    """
    sys.path.append(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(WORKSPACE, '..')))
    from lic_gen.lic_generator import local_flow
    shutil.copy(FEATURE_BOOK_PATH, os.path.join('D:\\lic_gen', FEATURE_BOOK_NAME))

    local_license_file_list = []
    record_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'update_record')
    license_files = local_flow(excel_file)
    for license_file in license_files:
        try:
            local_license_file = os.path.join(record_folder, os.path.basename(license_file))
            shutil.copy(license_file, local_license_file)
            local_license_file_list.append(local_license_file)
        except Exception as e:
            format_print(f"generate license file failed: {e}")
    return local_license_file_list


def deploy_to_server(license_files):
    """
    deploy the license files to servers
    :param license_files: list of license files path
    :return: None
    """
    os.chdir(WORKSPACE)
    bitanser_daemon = 'bitanswer'
    flex_daemon = 'flex'
    server_ip_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': '192.168.120.136',
        'rjy-td9020': '172.16.19.20',
        'jn-jira': '192.168.123.78',
        'rjy-td3059': '172.16.13.59',
        'rjy-td6059': '172.16.16.59',
        'rjy-td9059': '172.16.19.59',
        'jn-vmbuild5': '192.168.121.170'
    }
    server_daemon_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': flex_daemon,
        'rjy-td9020': flex_daemon,
        'jn-vmbuild5': flex_daemon,
        'jn-jira': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td3059': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td6059': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td9059': bitanser_daemon

    }
    server_license_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': '/export/license/prima_server_pack/prima_jn-dell03.lic',
        'rjy-td9020': '/export/license_server/prima_server_pack/prima_rjy-td9020.lic',
        'jn-vmbuild5': '/export/license/prima_server_pack/prima_jn-vmbuild5.lic',
        'jn-jira': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td3059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td6059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td9059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
    }
    for license_file in license_files:
        license_file_name = os.path.basename(license_file)
        for machine_name, daemon in server_daemon_dict.items():
            machine_ip = server_ip_dict.get(machine_name)
            if machine_name in license_file_name:
                start_time = time.time()
                if daemon == flex_daemon:
                    deploy_to_flex(machine_ip, server_license_dict.get(machine_name, ''), license_file)
                elif daemon == bitanser_daemon:
                    deploy_to_bitanswer(machine_ip, server_license_dict.get(machine_name, ''), license_file)
                else:
                    format_print(f"unknown daemon type: {daemon}")
                format_print(f"time usage: {time.time()-start_time} for {machine_ip} {daemon}")

def deploy_features_to_server(feature_info: dict, deploy_servers: list):
    """    
    :param feature_info: {product_number: feature_format}
    :para<|fim_suffix|>m
    return:
    """
    deploy_features = {}
    all_feature_dict = read_feature_book_normal(FEATURE_BOOK_PATH)
    for feature_number, feature_foramt in feature_info.items():
        feature_id = f"{feature_number}_{feature_foramt}"
        feature_info = all_feature_dict.get(feature_id, {})
        if feature_info:
            new_feature_id = f"{feature_number}_{feature_info.get('Feature Name', '')}"
            deploy_features.update({new_feature_id: feature_info})
        else:
            format_print(f"feature {feature_id} not found in feature book")
    excel_attch = generate_excel_file(deploy_features, deploy_servers=deploy_servers)
    license_file_list = generate_license_file(excel_attch)
    deploy_to_server(license_file_list)

def generate_license_file(excel_file):
    """
    call the lic_generator to generate license file according to the excel file
    :param excel_file:
    :return:
    """
    sys.path.append(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(WORKSPACE, '..')))
    from lic_gen.lic_generator import local_flow
    shutil.copy(FEATURE_BOOK_PATH, os.path.join('D:\\lic_gen', FEATURE_BOOK_NAME))

    local_license_file_list = []
    record_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'update_record')
    license_files = local_flow(excel_file)
    for license_file in license_files:
        try:
            local_license_file = os.path.join(record_folder, os.path.basename(license_file))
            shutil.copy(license_file, local_license_file)
            local_license_file_list.append(local_license_file)
        except Exception as e:
            format_print(f"generate license file failed: {e}")
    return local_license_file_list


def deploy_to_server(license_files):
    """
    deploy the license files to servers
    :param license_files: list of license files path
    :return: None
    """
    os.chdir(WORKSPACE)
    bitanser_daemon = 'bitanswer'
    flex_daemon = 'flex'
    server_ip_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': '192.168.120.136',
        'rjy-td9020': '172.16.19.20',
        'jn-jira': '192.168.123.78',
        'rjy-td3059': '172.16.13.59',
        'rjy-td6059': '172.16.16.59',
        'rjy-td9059': '172.16.19.59',
        'jn-vmbuild5': '192.168.121.170'
    }
    server_daemon_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': flex_daemon,
        'rjy-td9020': flex_daemon,
        'jn-vmbuild5': flex_daemon,
        'jn-jira': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td3059': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td6059': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td9059': bitanser_daemon

    }
    server_license_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': '/export/license/prima_server_pack/prima_jn-dell03.lic',
        'rjy-td9020': '/export/license_server/prima_server_pack/prima_rjy-td9020.lic',
        'jn-vmbuild5': '/export/license/prima_server_pack/prima_jn-vmbuild5.lic',
        'jn-jira': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td3059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td6059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td9059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
    }
    for license_file in license_files:
        license_file_name = os.path.basename(license_file)
        for machine_name, daemon in server_daemon_dict.items():
            machine_ip = server_ip_dict.get(machine_name)
            if machine_name in license_file_name:
                start_time = time.time()
                if daemon == flex_daemon:
                    deploy_to_flex(machine_ip, server_license_dict.get(machine_name, ''), license_file)
                elif daemon == bitanser_daemon:
                    deploy_to_bitanswer(machine_ip, server_license_dict.get(machine_name, ''), license_file)
                else:
                    format_print(f"unknown daemon type: {daemon}")
                format_print(f"time usage: {time.time()-start_time} for {machine_ip} {daemon}")

def deploy_features_to_server(feature_info: dict, deploy_servers: list):
    """    
    :param feature_info: {product_number: feature_format}
    :param <|fim_suffix|>
    return:
    """
    deploy_features = {}
    all_feature_dict = read_feature_book_normal(FEATURE_BOOK_PATH)
    for feature_number, feature_foramt in feature_info.items():
        feature_id = f"{feature_number}_{feature_foramt}"
        feature_info = all_feature_dict.get(feature_id, {})
        if feature_info:
            new_feature_id = f"{feature_number}_{feature_info.get('Feature Name', '')}"
            deploy_features.update({new_feature_id: feature_info})
        else:
            format_print(f"feature {feature_id} not found in feature book")
    excel_attch = generate_excel_file(deploy_features, deploy_servers=deploy_servers)
    license_file_list = generate_license_file(excel_attch)
    deploy_to_server(license_file_list)

def generate_license_file(excel_file):
    """
    call the lic_generator to generate license file according to the excel file
    :param excel_file:
    :return:
    """
    sys.path.append(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(WORKSPACE, '..')))
    from lic_gen.lic_generator import local_flow
    shutil.copy(FEATURE_BOOK_PATH, os.path.join('D:\\lic_gen', FEATURE_BOOK_NAME))

    local_license_file_list = []
    record_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'update_record')
    license_files = local_flow(excel_file)
    for license_file in license_files:
        try:
            local_license_file = os.path.join(record_folder, os.path.basename(license_file))
            shutil.copy(license_file, local_license_file)
            local_license_file_list.append(local_license_file)
        except Exception as e:
            format_print(f"generate license file failed: {e}")
    return local_license_file_list


def deploy_to_server(license_files):
    """
    deploy the license files to servers
    :param license_files: list of license files path
    :return: None
    """
    os.chdir(WORKSPACE)
    bitanser_daemon = 'bitanswer'
    flex_daemon = 'flex'
    server_ip_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': '192.168.120.136',
        'rjy-td9020': '172.16.19.20',
        'jn-jira': '192.168.123.78',

        'rjy-td6059': '172.16.16.59',
        'rjy-td9059': '172.16.19.59',
        'jn-vmbuild5': '192.168.121.170'
    }
    server_daemon_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': flex_daemon,
        'rjy-td9020': flex_daemon,
        'jn-vmbuild5': flex_daemon,
        'jn-jira': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td3059': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td6059': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td9059': bitanser_daemon

    }
    server_license_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': '/export/license/prima_server_pack/prima_jn-dell03.lic',
        'rjy-td9020': '/export/license_server/prima_server_pack/prima_rjy-td9020.lic',
        'jn-vmbuild5': '/export/license/prima_server_pack/prima_jn-vmbuild5.lic',
        'jn-jira': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td3059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td6059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td9059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
    }
    for license_file in license_files:
        license_file_name = os.path.basename(license_file)
        for machine_name, daemon in server_daemon_dict.items():

                else:
                    format_print(f"unknown daemon type: {daemon}")
                format_print(f"time usage: {time.time()-start_time} for {machine_ip} {daemon}")

    deploy_to_server(license_file_list)

def generate_license_file(excel_file):
    """
    call the lic_generator to generate license file according to the excel file
    :param excel_file:
    :return:
    """
    sys.path.append(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(WORKSPACE, '..')))
    from lic_gen.lic_generator import local_flow
    shutil.copy(FEATURE_BOOK_PATH, os.path.join('D:\\lic_gen', FEATURE_BOOK_NAME))

    local_license_file_list = []
    record_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'update_record')
    license_files = local_flow(excel_file)
    for license_file in license_files:
        try:
            local_license_file = os.path.join(record_folder, os.path.basename(license_file))
            shutil.copy(license_file, local_license_file)
            local_license_file_list.append(local_license_file)
        except Exception as e:
            format_print(f"generate license file failed: {e}")
    return local_license_file_list


def deploy_to_server(license_files):
    """
    deploy the license files to servers
    :param license_files: list of license files path
    :return: None
    """
    os.chdir(WORKSPACE)
    bitanser_daemon = 'bitanswer'
    flex_daemon = 'flex'
    server_ip_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': '192.168.120.136',
        'rjy-td9020': '172.16.19.20',
        'jn-jira': '192.168.123.78',
        'rjy-td3059': '172.16.13.59',
        'rjy-td6059': '172.16.16.59',
        'rjy-td9059': '172.16.19.59',
        'jn-vmbuild5': '192.168.121.170'
    }
    server_daemon_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': flex_daemon,
        'rjy-td9020': flex_daemon,
        'jn-vmbuild5': flex_daemon,
        'jn-jira': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td3059': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td6059': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td9059': bitanser_daemon

    }
    server_license_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': '/export/license/prima_server_pack/prima_jn-dell03.lic',
        'rjy-td9020': '/export/license_server/prima_server_pack/prima_rjy-td9020.lic',
        'jn-vmbuild5': '/export/license/prima_server_pack/prima_jn-vmbuild5.lic',
        'jn-jira': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td3059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td6059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td9059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
    }
    for license_file in license_files:
        license_file_name = os.path.basename(license_file)
        for machine_name, daemon in server_daemon_dict.items():
            machine_ip = server_ip_dict.get(machine_name)
            if machine_name in license_file_name:
                start_time = time.time()
                if daemon == flex_daemon:
                    deploy_to_flex(machine_ip, server_license_dict.get(machine_name, ''), license_file)
                elif daemon == bitanser_daemon:
                    deploy_to_bitanswer(machine_ip, server_license_dict.get(machine_name, ''), license_file)
                else:
                    format_print(f"unknown daemon type: {daemon}")
                format_print(f"time usage: {time.time()-start_time} for {machine_ip} {daemon}")

def generate_license_file(excel_file):
    """
    call the lic_generator to generate license file according to the excel file
    :param excel_file:
    :return:
    """
    sys.path.append(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(WORKSPACE, '..')))
    from lic_gen.lic_generator import local_flow
    shutil.copy(FEATURE_BOOK_PATH, os.path.join('D:\\lic_gen', FEATURE_BOOK_NAME))

    local_license_file_list = []
    record_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'update_record')
    license_files = local_flow(excel_file)
    for license_file in license_files:
        try:
            local_license_file = os.path.join(record_folder, os.path.basename(license_file))
            shutil.copy(license_file, local_license_file)
            local_license_file_list.append(local_license_file)
        except Exception as e:
            format_print(f"generate license file failed: {e}")
    return local_license_file_list


def deploy_to_server(license_files):
    """
    deploy the license files to servers
    :param license_files: list of license files path
    :return: None
    """
    os.chdir(WORKSPACE)
    bitanser_daemon = 'bitanswer'
    flex_daemon = 'flex'
    server_ip_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': '192.168.120.136',
        'rjy-td9020': '172.16.19.20',
        'jn-jira': '192.168.123.78',
        'rjy-td3059': '172.16.13.59',
        'rjy-td6059': '172.16.16.59',
        'rjy-td9059': '172.16.19.59',
        'jn-vmbuild5': '192.168.121.170'
    }
    server_daemon_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': flex_daemon,
        'rjy-td9020': flex_daemon,
        'jn-vmbuild5': flex_daemon,
        'jn-jira': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td3059': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td6059': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td9059': bitanser_daemon

    }
    server_license_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': '/export/license/prima_server_pack/prima_jn-dell03.lic',
        'rjy-td9020': '/export/license_server/prima_server_pack/prima_rjy-td9020.lic',
        'jn-vmbuild5': '/export/license/prima_server_pack/prima_jn-vmbuild5.lic',
        'jn-jira': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td3059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td6059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td9059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
    }
    for license_file in license_files:
        license_file_name = os.path.basename(license_file)
        for machine_name, daemon in server_daemon_dict.items():
            machine_ip = server_ip_dict.get(machine_name)
            if machine_name in license_file_name:
                start_time = time.time()
                if daemon == flex_daemon:
                    deploy_to_flex(machine_ip, server_license_dict.get(machine_name, ''), license_file)
                elif daemon == bitanser_daemon:
                    deploy_to_bitanswer(machine_ip, server_license_dict.get(machine_name, ''), license_file)
                else:
                    format_print(f"unknown daemon type: {daemon}")
                format_print(f"time usage: {time.time()-start_time} for {machine_ip} {daemon}")

def generate_license_file(excel_file):
    """
    call the lic_generator to generate license file according to the excel file
    :param excel_file:
    :return:
    """
    sys.path.append(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(WORKSPACE, '..')))
    from lic_gen.lic_generator import local_flow
    shutil.copy(FEATURE_BOOK_PATH, os.path.join('D:\\lic_gen', FEATURE_BOOK_NAME))

    local_license_file_list = []
    record_folder = os.path.join(WORKSPACE, 'update_record')
    license_files = local_flow(excel_file)
    for license_file in license_files:
        try:
            local_license_file = os.path.join(record_folder, os.path.basename(license_file))
            shutil.copy(license_file, local_license_file)
            local_license_file_list.append(local_license_file)
        except Exception as e:
            format_print(f"generate license file failed: {e}")
    return local_license_file_list


def deploy_to_server(license_files):
    """
    deploy the license files to servers
    :param license_files: list of license files path
    :return: None
    """
    os.chdir(WORKSPACE)
    bitanser_daemon = 'bitanswer'
    flex_daemon = 'flex'
    server_ip_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': '192.168.120.136',
        'rjy-td9020': '172.16.19.20',
        'jn-jira': '192.168.123.78',
        'rjy-td3059': '172.16.13.59',
        'rjy-td6059': '172.16.16.59',
        'rjy-td9059': '172.16.19.59',
        'jn-vmbuild5': '192.168.121.170'
    }
    server_daemon_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': flex_daemon,
        'rjy-td9020': flex_daemon,
        'jn-vmbuild5': flex_daemon,
        'jn-jira': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td3059': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td6059': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td9059': bitanser_daemon

    }
    server_license_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': '/export/license/prima_server_pack/prima_jn-dell03.lic',
        'rjy-td9020': '/export/license_server/prima_server_pack/prima_rjy-td9020.lic',
        'jn-vmbuild5': '/export/license/prima_server_pack/prima_jn-vmbuild5.lic',
        'jn-jira': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td3059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td6059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td9059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
    }
    for license_file in license_files:
        license_file_name = os.path.basename(license_file)
        for machine_name, daemon in server_daemon_dict.items():
            machine_ip = server_ip_dict.get(machine_name)
            if machine_name in license_file_name:
                start_time = time.time()
                if daemon == flex_daemon:
                    deploy_to_flex(machine_ip, server_license_dict.get(machine_name, ''), license_file)
                elif daemon == bitanser_daemon:
                    deploy_to_bitanswer(machine_ip, server_license_dict.get(machine_name, ''), license_file)
                else:
                    format_print(f"unknown daemon type: {daemon}")
                format_print(f"time usage: {time.time()-start_time} for {machine_ip} {daemon}")

def deploy_to_server(license_files):
    """
    deploy the license files to servers
    :param license_files: list of license files path
    :return: None
    """
    os.chdir(WORKSPACE)
    bitanser_daemon = 'bitanswer'
    flex_daemon = 'flex'
    server_ip_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': '192.168.120.136',
        'rjy-td9020': '172.16.19.20',
        'jn-jira': '192.168.123.78',
        'rjy-td3059': '172.16.13.59',
        'rjy-td6059': '172.16.16.59',
        'rjy-td9059': '172.16.19.59',
        'jn-vmbuild5': '192.168.121.170'
    }
    server_daemon_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': flex_daemon,
        'rjy-td9020': flex_daemon,
        'jn-vmbuild5': flex_daemon,
        'jn-jira': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td3059': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td6059': bitanser_daemon,
        'rjy-td9059': bitanser_daemon

    }
    server_license_dict = {
        'jn-dell03': '/export/license/prima_server_pack/prima_jn-dell03.lic',
        'rjy-td9020': '/export/license_server/prima_server_pack/prima_rjy-td9020.lic',
        'jn-vmbuild5': '/export/license/prima_server_pack/prima_jn-vmbuild5.lic',
        'jn-jira': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td3059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td6059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
        'rjy-td9059': '/opt/bitanswer/service/new_license',
    }
    for license_file in license_files:
        license_file_name = os.path.basename(license_file)
        for machine_name, daemon in server_daemon_dict.items():
            machine_ip = server_ip_dict.get(machine_name)
            if machine_name in license_file_name:
                start_time = time.time()
                if daemon == flex_daemon:
                    deploy_to_flex(machine_ip, server_license_dict.get(machine_name, ''), license_file)
                elif daemon == bitanser_daemon:
                    deploy_to_bitanswer(machine_ip, server_license_dict.get(machine_name, ''), license_file)
                else:
                    format_print(f"unknown daemon type: {daemon}")
                format_print(f"time usage: {time.time()-start_time} for {machine_ip} {daemon}")

def deploy_features_to_server(feature_info: dict, deploy_servers: list):
    """    

    :param feature_info: {product_number: feature_format}
    :param deploy_servers: list of servers to deploy to
    return:
    """
    deploy_features = {}
    all_feature_dict = read_feature_book_normal(FEATURE_BOOK_PATH)
    for feature_number, feature_foramt in feature_info.items():
        feature_id = f"{feature_number}_{feature_foramt}"
        feature_info = all_feature_dict.get(feature_id, {})
        if feature_info:
            new_feature_id = f"{feature_number}_{feature_info.get('Feature Name', '')}"
            deploy_features.update({new_feature_id: feature_info})
        else:
            format_print(f"feature {feature_id} not found in feature book")
    excel_attch = generate_excel_file(deploy_features, deploy_servers=deploy_servers)
    license_file_list = generate_license_file(excel_attch)
    deploy_to_server(license_file_list)
